description: This Java source file defines the ModelField class, which models the <field> element in an entity model within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, accessing, and serializing field metadata, including encryption, validation, and database mapping details.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a model of a <field> element in an entity, including properties like name, type, encryption, validation, and database column mapping. It is immutable once created.

classes.name: ModelField.EncryptMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for encryption status of the field, with methods to check if the field is encrypted.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory methods to instantiate ModelField objects with various parameters, including from XML elements and database info.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the field.

methods.name: getColName
methods.description: Returns the database column name for the field.

methods.name: getColValue
methods.description: Returns the column value or name if value is empty.

methods.name: getIsPk
methods.description: Indicates if the field is part of the primary key.

methods.name: getIsNotNull
methods.description: Indicates if the field cannot be null.

methods.name: getEncrypt
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the field is encrypted.

methods.name: getEncryptMethod
methods.description: Returns the encryption method used for the field.

methods.name: getEnableAuditLog
methods.description: Indicates if the field is included in audit logs.

methods.name: getIsAutoCreatedInternal
methods.description: Indicates if the field was auto-generated internally.

methods.name: getFieldSet
methods.description: Returns the field set name this field belongs to.

methods.name: getValidators
methods.description: Returns the list of validators for the field.

methods.name: toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the field to an XML element.
